label: serves objective
description: The Objective an Intent was derived from.

label: shaped by
description: Context that gives the Intent or Task its situational meaning.

label: draws on
description: Memory and Observations the Context was assembled from.

label: concerns
description: The Work Item the Intent, Task, or Action is about.

label: constrained by
description: Policies that apply.

label: requires assurance
description: The highest Assurance Level at which this work may be done. The effective level is the lowest of the Intent's, the Task's, the Skill's, and the performing Agent's autonomy_level.

label: realizes
description: The Intent the Plan is meant to fulfill.

label: planned by
description: The Actor (usually an Orchestrator) that produced the Plan.

label: has task
description: The Tasks that make up the Plan.

label: depends on
description: Tasks that must complete before this one can start.

label: assigned to
description: The Actor responsible for performing the Task.

label: requires role
description: The Role an Actor must fill to take the Task.

label: fills role
description: Roles the Actor is authorized to fill.

label: has skill
description: Skills the Actor can invoke.

label: performed by
description: The Actor that carried out the Action.

label: fulfills
description: The Task the Action was performed for.

label: invokes
description: The Skill the Action used.

label: approved by
description: People who confirmed the Action, Plan, or Result before it took effect. Required whenever the effective Assurance Level or a Policy calls for human confirmation.

label: generated by
description: The Action that produced this Result, Signal, or Observation.

label: derived from
description: The Signals an Observation was interpreted from.

label: about
description: What the Observation describes.

label: affects
description: Work Items whose state the Result changed.

label: has confidence
description: The Confidence attached to this Result, Observation, Action, or Plan.

label: compared against
description: The Assurance Level whose confidence threshold the Confidence was checked against.

label: contributes to
description: Outcomes this Result counts toward.

label: evaluates
description: The Objective the Outcome is measured against.

label: feedback on
description: What the Feedback is about.

label: provided by
description: Who gave the Feedback.

label: updates
description: What the Feedback changed.

label: writes to
description: Memory the Actor records its experience in.

label: enforces
description: The Policies and Assurance Levels the Guardian enforces.

label: oversees
description: What the Guardian watches.

label: escalates to
description: Where escalations go.
